a.xlink:title: A ClassTemplate implementation that knows how to extract/replace bytes in the underlying storage.
A ClassTemplate implementation that knows how to extract/replace bits in the underlying storage.
A base class for native ArrayDelegate implementations based on byte arrays.
A base class for native ArrayDelegate implementations based on bit arrays.
A base class for native ArrayDelegate<Bit> views that point to delegates holding byte arrays.
A base class for native ArrayDelegate<ViewType> views that point to delegates holding long arrays.
A base class for native ArrayDelegate implementations based on long arrays.
A base class for native ArrayDelegate<Bit> views that point to delegates holding double arrays.
The abstract base for RTDelegate<Int64> and RTDelegate<UInt64> implementations.
